meta.note: Computed by the real evaluator at build time. Run timestamps are demo dates; execution timestamps are those of the original recordings.

campaigns.name: Initial access to credential theft
campaigns.description: What an intruder does after the first foothold: run scripts and signed binaries, persist, escalate, dump credentials, learn the host and move with stolen hashes. Kerberoasting (T1558.003) is listed but cannot be scored: the recorded dataset holds no execution of it.

campaigns.name: Ransomware precursors
campaigns.description: The steps that usually come right before encryption: remote execution and services, new accounts, tampering with Defender and logs, staging data, discovery and deleting recovery points.

rulesets.notes: Starter set: 15 well-known SigmaHQ rules a team enables first (LSASS dumping with ProcDump, shadow copy deletion, event log clearing, Run key and scheduled task persistence, new local users, certutil downloads, regsvr32 and mshta abuse, PsExec) plus two Windows Security/System log rules and the Security-channel pass-the-hash rule. The recorded telemetry has no Security or System channel, so those three can show nothing here.

gaps.notes: Partial: detected via related technique T1218.005: Suspicious JavaScript Execution Via Mshta.EXE [67f113fa-e23d-4271-befa-30113b3e08b1]; noisy rule(s) for this technique earned no credit: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64 [fb843269-508c-4b76-8b8d-88679db22ce7] (5 baseline hits). Closed in run 4 (rule set v4): Suspicious PowerShell Download and Execute Pattern, PowerShell Encoded Command Outside The Remote Management Harness.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 1 (or Security 4688 with command-line auditing) and PowerShell Script Block Logging (event 4104) so encoded and in-memory scripts are visible.
gaps.rule_idea: Match powershell.exe or pwsh.exe command lines with download cradles (Net.WebClient, DownloadString, Invoke-WebRequest) combined with IEX or -EncodedCommand.

gaps.notes: Partial: detected via related technique T1543.003: Suspicious New Service Creation [17a1be64-8d88-40bf-b5ff-a4f7a50ebcc8]; New Service Creation Using Sc.EXE [85ff530b-261d-48c6-a441-facaa2e81e48]. Still open in run 4 (rule set v4): partial. Only rules tagged with other techniques (service creation) or the parent T1569 fire; no bundled rule is tagged T1569.002, so partial is the honest result.
gaps.telemetry_needed: System log event 7045 (service installed) and Security 4697; Sysmon event 1 for services.exe children and sc.exe.
gaps.rule_idea: Match a new service whose image path is a command interpreter, a user-writable path or a random name such as PSEXESVC, and services.exe spawning cmd.exe.

gaps.notes: Partial: noisy rule: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64 [fb843269-508c-4b76-8b8d-88679db22ce7] (5 baseline hits). Closed in run 4 (rule set v4): Suspicious Execution of Systeminfo.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 1 or Security 4688 with command-line auditing.
gaps.rule_idea: Match systeminfo.exe, and clusters of discovery commands (hostname, ver, wmic os) from one parent process.

gaps.notes: Partial: parent-technique rule: Psexec Execution [730fc21b-eaff-474b-ad23-90fd265d4988]. Still open in run 4 (rule set v4): partial. The PsExec rule is tagged with the parent technique T1021 only and no bundled rule is tagged T1021.002; the recording also holds just 10 events.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Security 5140/5145 (share access) and 4624 logon type 3 on the destination; Sysmon event 3 for port 445; Sysmon event 1 for net use.
gaps.rule_idea: Match access to ADMIN$ or C$ followed by a service install (7045) or file creation under Windows\System32 from the same source.

gaps.notes: Missed: no rule in the rule set is tagged for this technique. Closed in run 4 (rule set v4): 7-Zip Archive Created With Split Volumes Or Maximum Compression.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 1 with command line for archiving tools (7z, rar, tar) and Sysmon event 11 for the archive file.
gaps.rule_idea: Match 7z.exe/rar.exe with password (-p), split volume or maximum compression switches, and archives created in staging directories.

gaps.notes: Partial: noisy rule: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64 [fb843269-508c-4b76-8b8d-88679db22ce7] (5 baseline hits). Not re-run yet: rule set v4 detects this on the same recorded telemetry (UAC Bypass Via Shell Open Command Hijack, Bypass UAC via Fodhelper.exe, UAC Disabled); re-run the campaign to confirm.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 13 on the shell\open\command keys under HKCU\Software\Classes and Sysmon event 1 with integrity level for auto-elevating binaries.
gaps.rule_idea: Match eventvwr.exe, fodhelper.exe or computerdefaults.exe spawning a shell, and writes to HKCU\Software\Classes\*\shell\open\command.

gaps.notes: Missed: no rule in the rule set is tagged for this technique. Not re-run yet: rule set v4 detects this on the same recorded telemetry (Rundll32 Runs Inline Script Through Mshtml RunHTMLApplication, Rundll32 Execution With Uncommon DLL Extension); re-run the campaign to confirm.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 1 with command line and parent image, Sysmon event 3 for rundll32.exe network connections, Sysmon event 7 for unusual DLL loads.
gaps.rule_idea: Match rundll32.exe with javascript:, vbscript:, mshtml,RunHTMLApplication or a DLL with a non-.dll extension, and rundll32.exe making outbound connections.

gaps.notes: Partial: noisy rule: Suspicious Execution of Powershell with Base64 [fb843269-508c-4b76-8b8d-88679db22ce7] (5 baseline hits). Not re-run yet: rule set v4 detects this on the same recorded telemetry (Dumping of Sensitive Hives Via Reg.EXE, Copying Sensitive Files with Credential Data); re-run the campaign to confirm.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Sysmon event 1 for reg.exe, Sysmon event 11 for hive copies, Security 4656/4663 on the SAM key with registry auditing.
gaps.rule_idea: Match reg.exe save/export of HKLM\SAM, SYSTEM or SECURITY, and shadow-copy based copies of the config\SAM file.

gaps.notes: Telemetry gap: rules tagged for this technique cannot match this telemetry: 8eef149c-bd26-49f2-9e5a-9b00e3af499b: channel 'Security' is not in the telemetry (needed for logsource service 'security'). No bundled rule set detects this. Limit of the recorded data: the run launched mimikatz interactively with no sekurlsa::pth on the command line, and the recording has no Security channel, so logon-based pass-the-hash rules cannot be evaluated in recorded mode.
gaps.telemetry_needed: Security 4624 logon type 9 or type 3 with NTLM and Sysmon event 10 for credential-tool process access; ideally Security events from the destination host.
gaps.rule_idea: Match 4624 type 9 with logon process seclogo and an empty or mismatched key length, and NTLM network logons from a workstation to many hosts.
